# Incentive failure mode

## Mechanism under attack
Which score, badge, challenge rule, attribution rule, governance process, or reputation signal is vulnerable?

## Failure mode
Describe how a rational participant could optimize the visible rule while reducing truth, usefulness, fairness, safety, or public benefit.

## Minimal demonstration
Provide the smallest safe example that makes the failure reproducible. Do not escalate harm merely to make the example dramatic.

## Expected bad behavior
What behavior would this incentive create at scale?

## Who bears the cost
Which contributors, communities, reviewers, maintainers, or downstream users would be harmed or disadvantaged?

## Detection
What observable evidence would distinguish this failure from ordinary disagreement or legitimate strategy?

## Proposed mitigation
Suggest a rule, test, score change, provenance requirement, review process, or governance control that could reduce the problem.

## Regression test
How could we permanently test that this failure mode has not reappeared?

## New failure modes introduced
How might the proposed mitigation itself be gamed?

## Disclosure sensitivity
Does this report contain security-, safety-, privacy-, or abuse-sensitive details that should be handled privately before full public disclosure?
